exposure: Caesarean section as a mode of delivery
cohort: 174 mothers receiving treatment in different hospitals in Riyadh.
finding: The prevalence of PPD among the study participants was high (38.5%), and significant predictors of PPD included unsupportive spouse, recent stressful life events, and cesarean section delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was a significant predictor of postpartum depression.
